title: first-qa plan next_command points at apply (not re-plan)
summary: plan_first_qa_seed dry-run/runner_required and assess_adoption_readiness (core_ready unseeded) set next_command to --apply-first-qa instead of circular --first-qa-plan; seeded/applied still route to feed. what_next first_qa prompt mentions apply step.
migration_impact: Additive routing only. Agents should execute next_command (apply-first-qa + runner) instead of re-planning from adopt status or first-qa dry-run.
agent_notes: On core_ready + first_qa unseeded, gh plate adopt --json next_command is apply-first-qa (runner required). Do not loop on plan-only. Parent Epic #1000.
